description: Port the extension-based provider registration system. Extensions can register custom LLM providers at runtime via registerProvider/unregisterProvider. Upstream types.ts 1222-1351, runner.ts 261-331 (bindCore flushes queued registrations). ProviderConfig: baseUrl, apiKey, api type, streamSimple (custom stream handler), headers, authHeader, models (ProviderModelConfig array), oauth (full OAuth flow: login, refreshToken, getApiKey, modifyModels). ProviderModelConfig: model ID, name, API override, reasoning support, input types, cost tracking, contextWindow, maxTokens, compat. Registrations queued during load, flushed live after bindCore.
title: Provider registration via extensions
